overview_description.description: Probably Genetic is changing the lives of patients living with severe, complex diseases. Our technology discovers patients online, analyzes their disease state using AI and at-home testing, and connects patients to relevant resources. In doing so, we help patients access diagnoses, interventions, and resources as early as possible. Our data platform is used by drug developers and patient advocacy groups to develop and launch treatments for these patients.

product.name: No-Cost Genetic Testing Program
product.description: A patient-initiated program offering free clinical-grade genetic testing for over 4,000 rare diseases via at-home saliva or cheek swab samples.

identifier.value: Free Genetic Testing for Frontotemporal Dementia (FTD)

product.name: Free Genetic Testing for Frontotemporal Dementia (FTD)
product.description: A free, at-home genetic test for individuals in the US with symptoms suggestive of frontotemporal dementia, including genetic counseling and physician-ordered testing.

identifier.value: Free Genetic Testing for Pediatric Seizure Disorders

product.name: Free Genetic Testing for Pediatric Seizure Disorders
product.description: A no-cost genetic testing program for US patients (except New York) with symptoms indicative of pediatric seizure disorders, including at-home sample collection and counseling.

identifier.value: Free Genetic Testing for Mitochondrial Disease

product.name: Free Genetic Testing for Mitochondrial Disease
product.description: A free genetic testing program for US patients with symptoms suggestive of mitochondrial disease, including whole genome sequencing and genetic counseling.

product.name: Genetic Counseling and Testing via Insurance or Self-Pay
